jei.holeydigsite.info_drills_1: Mining Drills dig dirt clumps automatically when placed on Dirtrock (or any rock for Tier 3).
jei.holeydigsite.info_drills_2: Water-powered: connect a water pipe from a Water Intake to the back port to run.
jei.holeydigsite.info_sluice_starter_1: The Starter Sluice Box is one block: clumps go in at the back, finds collect in the tray at the front.
jei.holeydigsite.info_sluice_starter_2: Water ports on both sides. It holds one insert.
jei.holeydigsite.info_sluice_long_1: The long sluice is three blocks: two in a line (tray end towards you) and a chute on top of the back end. It needs the space free to place.
jei.holeydigsite.info_sluice_long_2: Clumps go in at the chute, from the top or any side but the front. Water ports are on both sides of the back part. Empty hand on any part empties the tray.
jei.holeydigsite.info_sluice_long_3: Two insert slots: a Riffle Insert and a Fine Mesh Screen or Seed Screen can work together, but not the same one twice.
jei.holeydigsite.info_drills_3: Outputs into the pan, belt, or sluice box directly in front.
jei.holeydigsite.info_belts_1: Conveyor belts transport dirt clumps and items.
jei.holeydigsite.info_belts_2: Powered by adjacent water pipes or water-powered belts.
jei.holeydigsite.info_belts_3: Filter Belts sort matching items sideways. Splitters alternate outputs evenly. Drop Chutes pass items vertically down.
jei.holeydigsite.info_shop_pads_2: Place items on the Sell Pad and press the adjacent Shop Button to sell for coins.
jei.holeydigsite.info_shop_pads_3: Place blueprints on the Buy Pad with coins in the adjacent Money Pan and press the Shop Button to buy.
jei.holeydigsite.info_shop_pads_4: Blueprints are purchased from Shop Displays in stores and kiosks.
jei.holeydigsite.info_contract_board_1: Wall board in the Trading Post showing %s personal daily contracts.
jei.holeydigsite.info_contract_board_2: Right-click with requested items to deliver. Finished contracts reward coins, Renown, and crates.
jei.holeydigsite.info_contract_board_3: Refreshes every in-game day (unfinished contracts stay up to %s days).
jei.holeydigsite.info_skin_bench_1: Put a drill or sluice on the bench, then use a matching Skin Kit on it. The old skin comes back as a kit.
jei.holeydigsite.info_skin_bench_2: Hold use on the bench for the wheel: pick a kit you carry, or take the skin off.
jei.holeydigsite.info_skin_bench_3: Sneak-use a kit on the bench twice to scrap it for Skin Scrap.
jei.holeydigsite.info_skin_kit_1: One machine skin as an item: trade it, or put it on at a Skin Bench.
jei.holeydigsite.info_skin_kit_2: A drill kit only fits drills, a sluice kit only sluices. Found in Mining Crates and Ledger levels.
jei.holeydigsite.info_picks_1: Prospecting tools for finding underground rocks.
jei.holeydigsite.info_picks_2: Right-click to prospect the ground below. Swap the pick head for Sand or Gravel detection.
jei.holeydigsite.info_picks_3: The Assayer's Pick (Crafting Forge) detects every rock type and counts nearby veins.

field_guide.holeydigsite.page.dig_and_pa: Scoop Dirtrock with your Wooden Shovel to get dirt.
Place your Pan in water, then right-click it with the full shovel.
Hold right-click on the Pan with your Brush until the finds pop out.
field_guide.holeydigsite.page.sell.title: 2. Sell your finds
field_guide.holeydigsite.page.sell.line1: Right-click your chunks and gems onto the Trading Post's Sell Pad.
field_guide.holeydigsite.page.sell.line2: Press the Shop Button next to the pad to sell the pile.
field_guide.holeydigsite.page.sell.line3: Coins land in the Money Pan. An empty hand takes them out.
field_guide.holeydigsite.page.buy.title: 3. Buy gear and machines
field_guide.holeydigsite.page.buy.line1: Take a Blueprint from a Shop Display and put it on the Buy Pad.
field_guide.holeydigsite.page.buy.line2: The Money Pan pays for it, so keep coins in there.
field_guide.holeydigsite.page.buy.line3: Press the Shop Button to buy. Your change stays in the pan.
field_guide.holeydigsite.page.first_line: Place a Water Intake in water and pipe it to a Drill and a Sluice.
Set the Drill on Dirtrock with its front at the Sluice's back.
Clumps go into the Sluice and the finds collect in its tray.
field_guide.holeydigsite.page.belts.line: Conveyor Belts carry clumps from Drills to Sluices.
Put a belt in front of a Sluice's tray to carry its finds away.
Belt Splitters share a line out. Filter Belts sort items sideways.
field_guide.holeydigsite.page.metal.line: Run lava from a Lava Intake to a Forge, with a Crucible on top.
Right-click the Crucible with chunks and put a Mold in front.
Empty hand on the Crucible pours. Take the ingot when it cools.
field_guide.holeydigsite.page.land_plots: Buy a Land Deed and right-click that plot's board with it.
New plots bring better clumps, new metals and new gems.
Their kiosks sell things you won't find at home.
field_guide.holeydigsite.page.ledger.lin: Right-click your Prospector's Ledger to see your milestones.
Milestones give Renown, and each Ledger level pays a reward.
Collections shows what you've had from each crate.
